l-e-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.c: Ny isan'ny litera dia tsy mamaritra ny dikany.
l-e-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.d: Ireo fanontaniana roa dia samy manana marika fanontaniana.
l-e-m1-b05-10.s.s1.explain: Ny Can I help you? dia tolotra, midika hoe hanampy aho, ary ny Can you help me? dia fangatahana, midika hoe azafady mba hanampy ahy.

l-e-m1-b05-10.s.s2.model.1: Samy hafa ny manome ny fanampiana, ka izany no fenitra hampiavahana ireo fanontaniana roa.
